lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy₃Hg crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Dy₆Hg₂) distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Dy centers have 12 geometric neighbors (10 Dy, 2 Hg), while Hg centers have 12 Dy neighbors, with distances ranging from about 3.40 to 3.52 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Dy–Dy and Dy–Hg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
